query: For each candidate instrument what specific falsification tests (placebo outcomes, pre-period leads, differential timing checks) will we pre-register and what failure thresholds will trigger exclusion?

response.query: For each candidate instrument what specific falsification tests (placebo outcomes, pre-period leads, differential timing checks) will we pre-register and what failure thresholds will trigger exclusion?
response.answer: Pre-register falsification tests include placebo outcomes, pre-period leads, and differential timing checks. Failure thresholds for exclusion are set at p < 0.05. Results not meeting these criteria will be excluded.
